compatibility_changes: HyperFrames v0.8.22 reports host-interrupted FFmpeg work as retryable rather than a terminal render failure; reCast preserves an explicit retryable failure field for compatible producer diagnostics.

HyperFrames v0.8.23 adds caption-zone overlap checks and safer timeline linting; these are authoring/lint surfaces and do not require a rendering-runtime change in reCast's current HTML-only Studio path.

HyperFrames v0.8.24 transports bounded extraction failure evidence across service boundaries without exposing signed URLs; reCast independently sanitizes render failure evidence by bounding text, redacting signed URL patterns, and retaining stage/code/message/retryable metadata.
The compatibility implementation mirrors documented behavior and interfaces only; no upstream implementation code is copied.
policy: Track documented behavior and compatibility surfaces; do not copy upstream implementation code.
